en.quote: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
en.riddle: And the carcasses of men fall as dung upon the open field
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: דַּבֵּר כֹּה נְאֻם-יְהוָה וְנָפְלָה נִבְלַת הָאָדָם, כְּדֹמֶן עַל-פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וּכְעָמִיר מֵאַחֲרֵי הַקֹּצֵר וְאֵין מְאַסֵּֽף
he.riddle: וְנָפְלָה נִבְלַת הָאָדָם, כְּדֹמֶן עַל-פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
